banner: DESIGN ONLY - the grasp-focused world model is NOT TRAINED. Nothing on this page is a model output.

nodes.label: RGB-D / camera + joint state
nodes.purpose: Sensor inputs of the future system.

inputs: depth (1,H,W) - NOT available in the current simulator pipeline

nodes.sim2real: depth and camera calibration on the real robot are unverified

nodes.label: Perception / geometry encoder
nodes.purpose: Estimate box pose and grasp geometry from images instead of the privileged simulator box pose.
nodes.sim2real: REQUIRED to remove the privileged box pose; does not exist

nodes.label: Grasp-correction candidates
nodes.purpose: Deployable candidates only (no oracle inputs): the G2b deployable family D1, D2, H1 plus S0 control.
nodes.sim2real: O1 / O3 need the true box pose and cannot be deployed

nodes.label: Grasp-focused world model
nodes.purpose: Predict future grasp events for each candidate: acquired, retained, early slip, carry drop, release confirmed, placement success.

inputs: history window (H,D) of proprioception + estimated object state
outputs: event logits (6, T) over the horizon

nodes.sim2real: needs real contact / force signals that are unverified on the robot

nodes.label: Candidate risk scoring
nodes.purpose: Combine event probabilities into a risk score per candidate.
nodes.sim2real: calibration of the probabilities is required first (the WM3-B calibration gate FAILed)

nodes.label: Action selection
nodes.purpose: Choose the candidate with the lowest risk; fall back to nominal ACT when uncertain.

nodes.label: OpenArm controller
nodes.purpose: Real-robot controller interface (not part of this repository's validated results).

sim2real.note: used by WM3-B, by the labeller, and by the O1 / O3 corrections
simulator contact points and normal forces; real sensing path unknown

candidate_cards.text: Oracle depth cancel (needs true box pose)
